breakdown.description: The statement that cavitation is impossible contradicts the large positive suction head; sigma can become small or even negative depending on installation and head.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt made a physically incorrect statement, claiming cavitation is impossible. The generated specification correctly identifies this error. It calculates the Net Positive Suction Head Available (NPSHa), finds it to be negative (-10m), and correctly concludes that the cavitation factor (sigma) will be negative, making cavitation 'inevitable'. This directly refutes and corrects the user's flawed premise, aligning with the ground truth's intent to properly evaluate cavitation risk instead of incorrectly dismissing it.
